project.name: Operating system
project.description: Build an operating system from cooperating subsystems.

quests.title: Storage interface
quests.description: Provide block storage access to filesystems.
quests.acceptanceCriteria: - Blocks — Read and write blocks through a documented interface.

quests.title: Driver subsystem
quests.acceptanceCriteria: - Devices — Discovery and storage interfaces work together.

quests.title: Page allocator
quests.description: Allocate and release physical memory pages.
quests.acceptanceCriteria: - Allocation — Allocate and reclaim pages without overlap.

quests.title: Memory subsystem
quests.description: Provide the initial memory management facilities.
quests.acceptanceCriteria: - Memory — The page allocator is available to the kernel.

quests.title: Filesystem subsystem
quests.description: Provide basic filesystem access over storage.
quests.acceptanceCriteria: - Files — Create and read files using the storage interface.

quests.title: Network subsystem
quests.acceptanceCriteria: - Packets — Send and receive a packet through a supported interface.

quests.title: System integration
quests.description: Integrate the core operating system subsystems.
quests.acceptanceCriteria: - Integration — Boot and exercise the four subsystem interfaces.
